audit_notes: Recorded judgement calls, checked against the existing ru catalogue (not findings): (1) response_actions.answer_label 'Действия с финальным ответом' adds 'финальный', which en does not spell. The catalogue already renders the turn's closing answer as 'финальный ответ' (ui.settings.appearance.transcript_display_mode_setting.by_turn: 'отмечая финальный ответ хода'), the sibling response_actions.label is 'Действия с ответом', and the code requires the two toolbars to announce differently; the split is coherent and consistent. (2) row_menu.unarchive 'Восстановить разговор' equals header.restore_conversation: the same act on two surfaces, and the existing archived_hint already says 'пока вы не восстановите его'; 'Разархивировать' would be the unidiomatic calque. (3) sidebar.entity.manage 'Управление «X»' is a noun where the sidecar's tone says verb phrase; the infinitive 'Управлять «X»' cannot govern a quoted nominative name, and 'Управление' matches the existing ui.agents.navigation.legacy.title 'Управление агентами'. (4) jump_agent appends the generated title bare after a comma, exactly as the sidecar's tone prescribes ('the title after a comma'); the sidebar keys quote names because their English source carries typographic quotes. (5) The ui.chat.checkpoint.turn sidecar says its first character is lowercased inside the rail tick's sentence; the code at this head does not lowercase it (checkpoint-model.ts: 'embeds the same numbers rather than a lowercased copy'), and 'Ход N из M' is correct either way, so the stale sidecar wording is not a translation requirement.

This is pre-existing call-site formatting, not a defect in the translated value; no catalogue wording can fix it.
